title: Wonderful hooks!!!
text: Wonderful hooks!!!. These are nice and thick. The silver ones are just a bit shorter than the black so its great to have the 2 different sizes. These will be useful for hanging so many places. My first place is for my shepards hook in my yard. I have a bird feeder that needed to be hooked farther out so it wouldnt lean up against the rod. This hook brought it out farther so it hangs freely. I have been looking for something like these for a long time!!! You can hang them two ways, wider hook part can even hang over a thinner door for hats, clothing ,decorations etc. Im sure I will be hanging lots of things with these.lol.

product_metadata.title: AIIGOU S Hooks Heavy Duty S Shaped Hanging Hangers, Large Black Iron and Small Silver Stainless Steel Hook for Kitchen, Bathroom and Office, Pot, Coat and Bag (12 PCS)
features: Two Different Sizes To Meet You Different Needs: Our S hooks set including 2 sizes hooks, the black measures 90mm x 40 mm and the silver measures 77mm x 27mm. And both sizes are 4mm in thickness, thicker than other hooks in the market.
Heavy Duty Material: These S hooks are made of high quality material, durable and anti-rust. The both hooks are strong to withstand the weight of item hanging on it up to10kg.
Easy Organization: The hangers help you organize the items to save spaces, such as cooking utensils, cast iron pots or aprons in the kitchen, and toiletries in bathroom.
Different Design in Two Ends: These hooks have a tight hook portion at one end so that it is not easy to come off the wire shelf, and you can use the wide hook for hanging.
